title: acaena sanguisorbae subsp. antarctica
intro: Acaena sanguisorbae subsp. antarctica, commonly known as the New Zealand bugseed or woolly bugloss, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. This plant is traditionally used to treat various health conditions and is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Acaena sanguisorbae subsp. antarctica include wound healing, skin protection, and antiseptic properties, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating minor cuts and scrapes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
